summary: Frontend-only verification of two new UI behaviours in VisaScout: (1) removal of forced disclaimer full-screen gate + inline single-checkbox disclaimer that gates the Run live lookup button, and (2) Country autocomplete dropdowns on nationality/residence/destination fields. Full E2E lookup was also re-run with autocomplete-selected countries (India->India->Japan, Tourism) and completed successfully in ~65s, rendering visa-category, checklist, and sources-panel.
test_credentials: demo@visascout.app / Demo1234! (login uses data-testid auth-email / auth-password / auth-submit, NOT login-email/login-password as stated in the request)
seed_data_creation: None (used existing demo account). Created one live search: India->Japan Tourism (search id 62e72ddb-6468-4766-a42b-ee78322f888c).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new UI behaviours verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: (a) demo login lands directly on /app with no /disclaimer redirect; (b) run-lookup-btn is disabled on initial load, remains disabled with countries+purpose filled until disclaimer-checkbox is ticked, then becomes enabled; (c) disclaimer text contains both 'informational guidance only' and 'not legal advice'; (d) nationality autocomplete: typing 'ind' shows ['India','Indonesia'], clicking option-0 fills 'India' and closes dropdown; (e) residence autocomplete: typing 'ind' works similarly; (f) destination autocomplete: typing 'ger' shows ['Algeria','Germany','Niger','Nigeria'] (substring match, expected), typing 'jap' shows ['Japan']; (g) full submit navigates to /app/search/{id}, processing-state shown, polling completed in ~65s and visa-category + checklist + sources-panel all rendered. NOTE: the review request mentions data-testid 'login-email'/'login-password'/'login-submit' but the actual test IDs in /app/frontend/src/pages/Auth.jsx are 'auth-email'/'auth-password'/'auth-submit'. Adjust future scripts accordingly.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; all new behaviours function as specified.
